summary: Both editions were independently checked against every clause of the selected Greek. They preserve the groups’ differing eligibility for repentance, the urgency condition, death consequences, continuing penalty, and speaker distinctions without adding doctrinal conditions. Both follow the reader-facing servant and contextual repentance policies. Their notes accurately disclose the supplied apparatus reports, distinguish conjectures and the bracketed insertion from preserved readings, and retain the selected working readings without harmonizing alternatives. Acceptance is limited to fidelity to the supplied source and honest disclosure of the supplied reports; it does not authenticate unseen manuscripts or certify exhaustive collation.
